_comment: Drop-in docker daemon config for MOD worker hosts. Installs userns-remap (root-in-container → unprivileged UID on host) and registers gVisor as a secondary OCI runtime for nodes opting into UseSandboxRuntime. Install at /etc/docker/daemon.json, then `systemctl restart docker`.
_userns_remap_notes: 'default' creates a dockremap user on the host. root inside a container maps to a high-numbered UID outside.
BREAKING CHANGE at rollout: every bind-mounted directory on the host must be chown'd to the remapped UID range (/etc/subuid / /etc/subgid) before containers using it can write.
Workers that bind-mount /data (MOD volume) should set MOD_USERNS_ADJUSTED=1 and run the adjust-binds.sh helper at bootstrap.
Not compatible with --network=host; MOD workers don't use host networking anyway.
_gvisor_install_notes: Install runsc via the upstream Google Cloud gVisor installer:
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y runsc
Then set GVISOR_AVAILABLE=true in the mod-worker systemd unit so SelectRuntime() picks it up.
